text:
# Pre-market brief: Wed 2026-11-18 (~8:25 AM ET)

1. **NVDA beat-and-raise.** Q4 revenue guide is $130B ±3% vs $125.25B LSEG est., and NVDA is up ~3.4–3.7% pre after four straight losing sessions ([Investing/Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/nasdaq-futures-jump-as-nvidia-forecast-lifts-ai-trade-ahead-of-anthropic-pricing-5035347), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/nvidia-stock-earnings.html)). Chips and neoclouds are bid ([Morningstar/DJ](https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/202611182532/north-american-morning-briefing-stock-futures-rise-after-nvidia-earnings-soothe-ai-jitters)). Per lessons, the chip-group avoid holds through 11/19. The Anthropic IPO prices Thursday.
2. **Futures:** NDX +~1.1%, S&P +0.3–0.6%, Dow ~flat ([stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/news/stock-futures-rise-nvidia-q3-fy2027-results/)). VIX is above 25 ([Saxo](https://www.home.saxo/en-mena/content/articles/macro/market-quick-take---nvidia-tries-to-stabilize-after-strong-earnings---18-november-2026-18112026)).
3. **Rates/Fed:** 10-yr 5.092%, 2-yr 4.791%. FedWatch shows ~95% odds of a December hike. FOMC minutes at 2 PM ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/treasury-yields-bonds-fed.html)).
4. **Oil/BTC/metals:** Brent ~$92 (−1%; API +5.3M bbl build). Gold is at a 14-month low ([Saxo](https://www.home.saxo/en-mena/content/articles/macro/market-quick-take---nvidia-tries-to-stabilize-after-strong-earnings---18-november-2026-18112026)). BTC is ~$64.1k, −1.1% ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/11/18/bitcoin-drops-as-nvidia-earnings-report-drives-stock-index-futures-higher)). Miners are lower pre.
5. **Retail prints:** TJX $140 (+7.8% pre) after it raised FY guidance and set a $3B buyback ([RTT](https://www.rttnews.com/3715910/tjx-companies-boosts-fy26-outlook-shares-surge-7-8-update.aspx?type=ern)). TGT −1% pre: EPS $2.65 vs $2.07 (includes $0.50 of tariff refunds), comps +5.6%, FY guide raised ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/target-beats-q3-estimates-but-shares-dip-5035573), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/stocks-moving-the-most-today-live-updates.html)). LOW −2.5–3%: margin squeeze, guide trimmed, two downgrades ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/why-is-lowes-stock-sliding-today-93CH-5035558)). LOW added to avoid.
6. **Calendar:** today, housing starts 8:30, EIA, 20-yr auction, minutes 2 PM, PANW AMC. Thu: WMT, PDD, BABA BMO; INTU, ROST, KEYS AMC; claims ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/earnings-calendar-week-of-november-16-2026)). Fri: UMich ([TenTrade](https://tentrade.com/en/weekly-market-outlook-16-20-november-2026/)).

**Swing ideas**
- **TGT** (long, low): beat-and-raise with best sales growth in 5 years and an un-gapped entry (−1% pre). Risk: the beat leans on tariff refunds, plus the hawkish-Fed tape.
- **TJX** (long, low, CONDITIONAL): raised guidance plus a $3B buyback, but it gapped >5%. Log at the 11/18 close only if it holds the gain. Risk: gap fade and a margin dip from freight.
